violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface Reach-in-cooler was not cleaned as frequently as required.--Nonfood contact surface Reach-in-Freezers bottom shelf was not cleaned as frequently as required.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. - Long, narrow cutting board on prep table containing deep/dark cuts. In need of resurfacing or replacement.
Toilet facilities. — --- Toilet rooms not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door.
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
